## Heat F1 predecessor

Heat F1 remains [predecessor evidence](../results/a7-paper-evidence/predecessor-f1.json) with its original parameter, Engine and source-state identities. Its frozen [heat-160 record](../results/heat-160/A-parameters.json) has SHA-256 `66ff7715958e9d22e77bd129faf7f67822204e3285b50993bf3f67d72c3b9778`; the replaced selected version 3 had SHA-256 `7b0b4bb5669c1b2061fd7ec26e5fb4c8491005bdb5ba8f9e22e4c0b0b4b84308`. The [six-fit study](../results/heat-final-170/fit-comparison.csv) and its [figures](../results/heat-final-170/figures/heat-of-absorption.png) remain retained. The [8298c602 wheel transfer](../results/engine-8298c602-adoption/README.md) reproduces only its named 152 F1 quantities within 2.9 × 10⁻¹² relative difference; it does not qualify every retained F1 result on the current wheel. Historical guards, including [Cp](../results/cp-unloaded-161/evaluate.py) and [density](../results/density-current-record-123/replay.py), remain unchanged. The LaTeX manuscript uses A7 since #197 (`dfc2780`); manuscript freshness checks concern its retained LaTeX inputs and do not establish A7 adoption.

**Provenance of the retained heat-fit evaluation.** [Frozen heat F1 record](../results/heat-160/A-parameters.json) SHA-256 `66ff7715958e9d22e77bd129faf7f67822204e3285b50993bf3f67d72c3b9778`; Engine wheel SHA-256 `94b55dfcf72f21b43010c7125d71f103f41fd56f7a6b6fe0774903eef71cc72a` from merged Engine commit `026b30311b959f1a5db4feef4c15e243f7044a5f`; [evaluation execution](../results/heat-final-170/evaluation/execution.json) records its use.
